levels.challengeEs: Pide una mesa para tres y un café de olla. Pregunta el precio primero.
levels.challengeEn: Change the table to three people and order a café de olla. Ask its price before ordering.
levels.successEn: Number of people + drink + price question + polite closing. Short, clear phrases are fine.
levels.sampleAnswerEs: Una mesa para tres, por favor. ¿Cuánto cuesta un café de olla? ... Uno, por favor.
levels.sampleAnswerEn: A table for three, please. How much is a café de olla? ... One, please. (40 MXN)

levels.challengeEs: Pide tres tacos de pollo sin cebolla, un americano y salsa aparte. Es para comer aquí.
levels.challengeEn: Order three chicken tacos with no onion, one americano, and salsa on the side. Eat at the café.
levels.successEn: Quantity + filling + topping change + salsa request + dine-in/takeout choice. Salsa color alone doesn't tell you how spicy it is; ask.
levels.sampleAnswerEs: Me da tres tacos de pollo sin cebolla, un americano y salsa aparte. Para comer aquí.
levels.sampleAnswerEn: Three chicken tacos without onion, an americano, and salsa on the side. To eat here. (119 MXN)

levels.challengeEs: Tienes 85 pesos. Mantén los dos tacos de nopales, elige una bebida y confirma el total.
levels.challengeEn: Your budget is now 85 pesos. Keep two cactus tacos, choose a drink you can afford, and confirm the total.
levels.successEn: Explain a restriction + ask about ingredients + choose an available alternative + stay within budget.
levels.sampleAnswerEs: Dos tacos de nopales y un americano, por favor. ¿Son ochenta y cinco pesos?
levels.sampleAnswerEn: Two cactus tacos and an americano, please. Is that eighty-five pesos? (A jamaica also works: 80 MXN.)

levels.challengeEs: No se puede pagar por separado. Propón un solo pago y explica cómo dividirán el gasto.
levels.challengeEn: The staff says separate payments are unavailable. Propose one payment and explain how you will split the cost.
levels.successEn: Describe the original request + identify the discrepancy + explain the correct total + negotiate a payment option without blaming the staff.
levels.sampleAnswerEs: No hay problema. Pago yo los ciento dieciséis pesos y luego dividimos el gasto: cincuenta y ocho cada quien.
levels.sampleAnswerEn: No problem. I will pay the 116 pesos, and then we will split it: 58 each.

levels.challengeEs: Hay una demora de 20 minutos y deben salir en 15. Negocia otra opción y confirma el acuerdo.
levels.challengeEn: There is now a 20-minute delay and you must leave in 15. Negotiate a feasible alternative and restate the final agreement.
levels.successEn: Explain the time constraint + evaluate alternatives + negotiate respectfully + confirm quantities, packaging, timing, and total.
levels.sampleAnswerEs: Como tenemos que salir en quince minutos, ¿habría algo que pudiera estar listo antes? Si no, tendríamos que cancelar la comida.
levels.sampleAnswerEn: Since we have to leave in fifteen minutes, could anything be ready sooner? Otherwise, we would need to cancel the food.
